notes: UI-free PlayniteSettingsService over the p4-004 migration envelope: typed read/update with documented v10 defaults, envelope validation through SettingsMigration.ExportV10, explicit MigrateFromV10Async, unknown/legacy preservation, Changed subscription, and sibling-temp atomic writes with an unchanged file on failure. Raw v10 configs are refused until explicitly migrated; corrupt or unsupported files never overwrite. Load also range-checks every modeled integer against its key's CLR type, so an out-of-range value is an explicit InvalidValue instead of an OverflowException on a typed read.
